label: Is hybrid culture
summary: Whether the culture was created by blending two other cultures.
details: Works on a culture. `yes` matches hybrid cultures, `no` matches cultures that are not.

label: Is immortal
summary: Whether the character is immortal.
details: Vanilla only ever uses it as `is_immortal = no`.

label: Is important decision
summary: Whether a decision counts as an important decision for the character.
details: Runs on a character and takes a decision as its value (the game's text words it the other way round, as the scoped decision being checked for a target character). The game does not say what makes a decision important. Vanilla uses it once, with a saved decision (`scope:decision`).

label: Is important location
summary: Whether the county is an important location for the given title.
details: Runs on a county title and takes another title as its value. The game does not say what makes a county important for a title, and vanilla does not use it.

label: Is imprisoned
summary: Whether the character is in prison.
details: Any prison counts, including house arrest. Use `is_in_prison_type` to ask for one kind.

label: Imprisoned by
summary: Whether the character is held in prison by the given character.
details: The checked character is the prisoner. The value is the jailer, usually a saved scope or `root`.

label: Is in an army
summary: Whether the character is part of an army, as a commander or a knight.

label: Is in civil war
summary: Whether the character is at war with their liege or with one or more of their vassals.

label: Is in debt
summary: Whether the character is in debt.
details: For a character who uses a treasury, it is true when the treasury is negative.

label: Is in religion family
summary: Whether the faith or religion belongs to the given religious family.
details: The value is a religion family key. Vanilla writes these with the `rf_` prefix, such as `rf_abrahamic` or `rf_pagan`. The game's own example spells it `abrhamic`, which looks like a typo.

fields.name: value
fields.values: a religion family key such as rf_eastern

label: In guest group
summary: Whether the character belongs to the given group of guests in the activity they take part in.
details: Without `phase` it checks the activity's current phase. With `phase` it checks all phases with that key. Vanilla also uses it for groups like entrants, supporters and detractors.

fields.name: name
fields.values: a guest subset key such as entrants or supporter

fields.name: phase
fields.text: Only check this phase of the activity.
fields.values: a phase key such as tournament_phase_melee

label: Next in line, outside region
summary: Whether the character is next in line for a clerical region title that would make them lose their land.
details: This happens when they hold land but the region does not overlap their realm: they lose their old realm on succession. Heads of faith can keep their realm.

label: Is in list
summary: Whether the thing currently being looked at is in the named script list.
details: The value is the name of a list that script built earlier, for example with `add_to_list`. The game's note names no scope. Vanilla uses it very often, mostly with `traits`.

label: In ongoing great holy war
summary: Whether the character is in a great holy war that has already started.
details: A great holy war that has been called but not begun does not count.

label: Is in pool at
summary: Whether the character waits in the character pool of the area the given province belongs to.
details: The value is a province. Vanilla uses it with saved provinces such as `scope:destination`.

label: In prison type
summary: Whether the character is imprisoned in the given kind of prison.
details: The game accepts any static modifier here. Vanilla uses only `dungeon` and `house_arrest`.

fields.name: value
fields.values: a prison type such as dungeon or house_arrest

label: In same court as
summary: Whether the character is in the same court as the given character.
details: That means they have the same court owner, or one is a courtier of the other. Guests do not count; see `is_in_the_same_court_as_or_guest`.

label: In same court or guest
summary: Whether the character is in the same court as the given character, with guests counted.
details: Same rule as `is_in_the_same_court_as` (same court owner, or one is a courtier of the other), but guests at the court also count.

label: Is inactive rite
summary: Whether the rite is inactive, meaning no characters and no counties follow it.
details: Works on a rite. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Is incapable
summary: Whether the character is incapable.
details: The game gives no further definition. Vanilla mostly writes `is_incapable = no`.

label: Is independent ruler
summary: Whether the character is an independent ruler.

label: Is knight
summary: Whether the character is a knight.

label: Knight of
summary: Whether the character is a knight of the given character.
details: The checked character is the knight. The value is the character they would be a knight of.

label: Is knight permitted
summary: Whether the character may be a knight under their liege's permissions.
details: The game's example is `is_knight_permitted = liege`, but vanilla's single use passes a template value (`$ARMY_OWNER$`). Which values work is therefore not confirmed.

label: Known by
summary: Whether the secret is known by the given character.
details: Works on a secret. The value is the character who might know it, often `root`.

label: Known by culture
summary: Whether the culture has learned the innovation.
details: Runs on an innovation and takes a culture as its value. Vanilla uses it a few times with saved cultures.

label: Is lake province
summary: Whether the province is a lake.

label: Is lakeside county
summary: Whether the county lies next to a lake.
details: Works on a county title.

label: Is lakeside province
summary: Whether the province lies next to a lake.

label: Is landed
summary: Whether the character holds a county or a barony.
details: Holding only a higher title without land on the map does not count; see `is_landless_ruler`.

label: Is landless ruler
summary: Whether the character holds a title but no land on the map.

label: Is landless-type title
summary: Whether the title is of a landless type.
details: Works on a title. The game does not say which titles that covers.

label: Is war leader
summary: Whether the character leads one of the sides in the given war.
details: The value is the war, usually `prev` or a saved war.

label: Leading faction type
summary: Whether the character leads a faction of the given type.
details: Vanilla uses types such as `peasant_faction`, `populist_faction` and `claimant_faction`.

label: Is leased out
summary: Whether the title is leased out.
details: Works on a title.

label: Is legend completed
summary: Whether the legend is completed.
details: Works on a legend. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Liege or above of
summary: Whether the character is the liege of the given character, or higher up in their chain of lieges.
details: The checked character is the higher one. The value is the one below.

label: Is local player
summary: Whether the character is the player on this computer.
details: An interface trigger: it works only in certain places, such as the game's interface. Vanilla uses it almost always as `yes`.

label: Is lowborn
summary: Whether the character is lowborn.

label: Is men-at-arms in combat
summary: Whether the men-at-arms regiment is in a battle.
details: Works on a regiment. Vanilla uses it once.
